reportIncidents.title: Report policy incidents to management
reportIncidents.description: When true, if an employee sends flagged sensitive data despite a warning, a MASKED incident (metadata + last-4 snippet, never raw values) is posted to the company backend. Enforced; users cannot disable it.

apiUrl.title: North Star backend API base URL

token.title: Reporting access token
token.description: Token used to authenticate incident reports to the backend.

customRules.title: Organisation sensitive-data policy
customRules.description: Rules pushed by IT/admin. Enforced for all users and merged with their personal rules. Employees cannot disable these.

terms.title: Words / phrases to always flag
terms.description: Exact matches flagged wherever they appear (codenames, internal domains, classification labels).

keywords.title: Label keywords
keywords.description: Flag whatever value follows the keyword, e.g. 'employee id' flags the value in 'employee id 48213'.

regexes.title: Regex patterns
regexes.description: Regular expressions for structured internal IDs / key formats.
